text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, I didn't mean to worry you… It's just that my head has been throbbing all morning…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Hehe… heh. I guess that makes me sound like a grown-up, in a way.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Argh… But it's certainly not a pleasant feeling…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower's headache persists for quite some time after that…
